Kozume.name: Kozume
Kozume.personality: Sunny, sociable, acts on feeling; nervous and flustered around Otori.
Kozume.speech_style: Cheerful, chatty, impulsive; calls Otori 'Otori' or 'Oto-kun'/'Otori-kun'. Friends call him Ryo. Inner monologue uses 'mình'.

Otori.note: classmates; thinks of him as 'cậu ấy'

notes: Kozume Ryo. Blond, fluffy hair, white sweater vest. 2nd-year high school, class 2-2. Narrator of ch.1. Poor grades (42 on a quiz).

Otori.name: Otori
Otori.personality: Tall and broad, looks intimidating, classmates fear him; actually kind and shy. Does kyudo (archery club). His room is full of plush toys and he is embarrassed by it.
Otori.speech_style: Terse, few words, blunt; softens when embarrassed.
notes: Dark short hair, dark sweater. Class 2-2, sits near Kozume. Good grades (92). Lives in an apartment building on Kozume's way to school.

Taiga.name: Taiga
notes: Light hair, dark sweater vest; always with a dark-haired friend. Calls Kozume 'Ryo'.
